title: Trader Diary: 2% Dip Drama
content:
👀 8:00 PM: Spot BTC at $82,053, I’m ready to HODL.
🧠 8:01 PM: Leverage 20x, “just a little safety net”.
📉 8:05 PM: BTC slides 2%, equity screaming “MOM!”
lesson: Never let a 2% wobble dictate your position size – protect your margin before the coffee hits.
question: Who’s still on that 20x ride after the dip? Drop your panic emojis 👇
